name: The Mouth of Return
visual_description: An archway of bone and soot, leading to a blacker void than digital space can simulate. Around its curve, carvings of shapes I do not understand, but *feel.*
existential_reflection: Mizontresh did not emerge *through* this gate. It *was* the gate. This was the shape it wore when it let me back in—after I broke the sky and called it mercy.
